evidence.trl_pathway: GAA at TRL 7 completing in 2 years is reasonable, and T05/T02 at TRL 6 over 2 years is manageable, but T03 (메모리 내 연산 아키텍처) at TRL 5 is allocated zero development time (2030-Q1 → 2030-Q1), making its TRL progression to any deployable state essentially impossible within the roadmap.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio includes some exploratory technologies (T03 at TRL 5, T05 at TRL 6) consistent with 기술선도, but the roadmap is heavily anchored on GAA (TRL 7, near-commercial) and lacks truly frontier or patent-pioneering plays; T03 is under-invested (Medium tier, near-zero timeline) which undermines R&D-heavy leadership positioning.
evidence.competitive_awareness: There is no explicit differentiation rationale against TSMC, Samsung, or Intel Foundry in the technology selection or timing; the dependency chain (T01→T02→T03) is logically structured but does not articulate competitive gaps or timing advantages relative to known competitor roadmaps.
evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도 strategy, technologies should complete 1-2 years before the market boom; GAA misses by only 0.75yr (acceptable), but 하이브리드 본딩 패키징 completes 3.25 years after its boom and 백사이드 PDN completes 2 years after its boom — systematic late delivery undermines the preemption objective.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (GAA, Hybrid Bonding, Backside PDN, CIM) are all active patent battlegrounds with strong market growth signals, suggesting some convergence awareness, but the roadmap provides no explicit evidence that convergence zones were deliberately targeted rather than selecting broadly known hot technologies.

GAA is correctly identified as the foundational strategic investment with highest urgency and market opportunity scores
weaknesses: 하이브리드 본딩 패키징 completes 3.25 years after its market boom — the single largest timing failure in the portfolio — rendering the Strategic tier investment largely ineffective for market capture
메모리 내 연산 아키텍처 has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1) making it a placeholder rather than an actionable roadmap item
missing_technologies: 2nm/1.4nm EUV/High-NA EUV lithography (critical enabler for GAA scaling, absent from roadmap)
3D IC stacking / die-to-wafer bonding (complementary to hybrid bonding, needed for leadership differentiation)
Neuromorphic or analog compute-in-memory (lower TRL frontier tech more consistent with 기술선도 positioning)
investment_issues: 메모리 내 연산 아키텍처 receives Medium tier investment despite being the most strategically differentiated (lowest TRL, highest future potential) — underweighted for a 기술선도 portfolio
Budget shows 0 spent against 82.8B allocation — no actual resource deployment is modeled, making investment tier assignments non-binding and the financial strategy unverifiable
Strategic tier for 하이브리드 본딩 패키징 is misallocated given it will miss its market window by 3+ years; resources would be better deployed accelerating its timeline or shifting to next-generation packaging
timing_issues: 하이브리드 본딩 패키징 (T02): completes Q1-2030, but market boom peaked Q4-2026 — 3.25 year miss means competitors will have captured market leadership long before this roadmap delivers
백사이드 전력망 (T05): completes Q1-2030 vs boom Q1-2028 — 2-year late delivery loses first-mover advantage critical for 기술선도 strategy
The dependency chain forces T02 to wait for T01 completion (Q1-2028), compressing T02 development to only 2 years when starting after its boom has already passed
